_readme: Frozen adoption-debt baselines for scripts/check-adoption.mjs (Lift 2a of docs/UX-MATURITY-PLAN.md).
A count may HOLD or SHRINK; a rise fails CI. Re-freeze after a sweep with `node scripts/check-adoption.mjs --update`
so this file reads as the scoreboard of what the sweeps bought. Numbers seeded 2026-08-04 by
re-measuring the verification round's census (UX-MATURITY-PLAN addendum) with this harness, at the
START of the wave, so the wave's own sweeps show up as a delta rather than as a silent zero.
Each entry: key · description · patterns (ripgrep-class, JS RegExp source, matched with the `g` flag) ·
optional `absent` patterns that disqualify a file · include/exclude globs over the POSIX repo-relative
path · mode (`matches` counts occurrences, `files` counts qualifying files) · baseline.

entries.description: Literal rounded-* utilities instead of the role radii (rounded-card / rounded-control / rounded-pill)
Literal Tailwind shadow-* instead of the DAWN depth language (lift-*)
Hardcoded monochromes (-white / -black / white\/NN) that ignore theme generations — the only bug class in the census
text-subtle paired with text-2xs/text-3xs on the same element — sub-AA by construction (Lift 3)
Raw <button> carrying bg-primary instead of the Button primitive (the census corrected the docs' '~18' by 27x)
Hand-rolled progress bars (rounded-full track + inline width style) instead of the ProgressTrack primitive
Files named *-card.tsx that render markup and do not compose EntityCard/PersonCard/StatCard/RowCard — browse cards owed to the kit
Files named *row*.tsx that render markup and do not compose RowCard — list rows owed to the kit
Hand-rolled underline tab strips (border-b-2 + px- padding) instead of the one UnderlineTabs vocabulary

Arbitrary px in SIZING/SPACING utilities (h-[18px], w-[22px], min-w-[180px] …) instead of the spacing scale. Ratcheted rather than hard-failed: ~140 sites predate the rule and no sweep owns them, so the gate holds the line while screen passes retire them (check:tokens still hard-fails text-[Npx], which has no legitimate use). Allowlisted: min-h/min-w-[44px] (the WCAG 2.5.5 tap-target floor, a load-bearing exact value), the -9999px offscreen idiom, the icon primitives (glyph optical sizing is their job), and the raster OG/print surfaces where px IS the unit.
